Definition: probably of foreign origin; a mattress:--bed.
BiblicalUsage: The mattress or pallet is the bed the sick lay on, and it shows up in the healing stories: the paralytic carried on his bed in Mark 2:4, the man at Bethesda told to take up his bed and walk in John 5:8, and Aeneas, who had kept his bed eight years, healed in Acts 9:33. The Greek text spells the word with double tau, κράβαττος, where the King James tradition has double beta.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it as given that this bed matters because Jesus kept telling people to pick it up: the thing that carried them became the proof they were healed.
